blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—La Salle star Jacob Cortez is listed as day-to-day due to a swollen right knee, according to assistant coach Oliver Bunyi. Cortez missed the Green Archers’ game on Sunday night but still beat University of Santo Tomas, 92-80, to move into third place in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball standings. Cortez sustained the injury in the second quarter of La Salle’s overtime win over University of the East on Wednesday. “What happened was, at least there was no damage, but there’s a little swelling.
